children: Trio Petroleum Corp reported results for the three months ended July 31, 2026, with revenue of $348581 a widened net loss of $1.97M, and diluted EPS of $(0.39) as the company continued to invest in Canadian heavy‑oil operations and recent acquisitions.
Revenue was $348,581 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, up from $192,395 in the year‑ago quarter (81.2% YoY).
Net income: Net loss of $1,971,426 for the three months ended July 31, 2026, compared with net loss of $1,386,723 in the year‑ago quarter (loss increased by $584,703, 42.2% YoY).
Diluted EPS was $(0.39) for the three months ended July 31, 2026, versus $(1.57) in the year‑ago quarter.
Revenue growth year‑to‑date was driven by expansion of Canadian asset production and new Alberta wells coming online.
Company shifted strategic focus to Canadian heavy‑oil assets, pursuing workovers and optimization on the Novacor and Capital Land acquisitions.
Permitting work continues for South Salinas in California; the company is evaluating joint‑venture and carbon capture options to unlock value in that region.
Two Vermilion River wells began producing in May 2026 and Saskatchewan assets materially increased near‑term output.
Proceeds from an at‑the‑market equity program funded operational activity and supported accelerated acquisition and development plans.
